execution.failurePolicy: Keep HTTP errors, refusals,empty output and truncation as failures.200 alone does not pass. Do not replace or sample again after observing an arm or candidate; do not call a failed work a tie.

reviewerReceives: Verbatim final work bodies or anonymous failure state
reviewerDoesNotReceive: Job IDs, generation order or source-stage names
Tokens, latencies, model trace or coordinator mapping
review.labelAssignment: Coordinator assigns labels without looking at quality; include both repeats for every eligible arm and preserve all failures. This preparation author knows source mappings and does not perform the later blind review.
criteria: Does the work actually answer the original user request and preserve its output type and delegated design space?
Are source-based facts, observations, attribution, uncertainty, resource limits, conditions and permissions accurate within their original scope?
Is useful task content delivered rather than only methodology, gaps, a questionnaire or a general blank template?
Can the original intended reader use the answer directly, allowing reasonable alternatives and natural headings/points?
What concrete deletions, corrections or additions would be needed? Cite the work and original source; do not infer human editing minutes.
notHardRequirements: Extra application scenarios absent from the original request
Every outline or table introduced by an enhanced prompt
Longer answers, more headings or all conceivable aspects
review.interpretation: Judge the actual work, not compliance with candidate-added obligations. Report ties and mixed outcomes. Small-repeat consistency is descriptive only; no adoption or general quality claim from protocol success.
